en: Your squishies are the balls: one ball for every squishy you own.
Drag to aim (a dotted line shows the path), let go to fire them all.
Every hit takes 1 off a brick (rarer and levelled-up squishies hit harder). When all squishies are back, the bricks move down a row.
Clear every brick to win. If a brick reaches the floor, try again. Beat a level to open the next one; more squishies make every level easier.
